goal: Prevent crashes or denial of service from file descriptor exhaustion by enforcing IPC connection limits
Allow node operators to set distinct connection limits for different IPC endpoints
reviewability: Ready to review: clean merge state, passing CI, and all reviewer concerns addressed with tests
agreement: Strong consensus favoring per-listener connection limits over a global setting
Support for fixing descriptor accounting and isolating limits by consumer role (ryanofsky, kevkevinpal)
Verified connection limiting behavior and file descriptor arithmetic (xyzconstant, ViniciusCestarii)
Tested socket option parsing edge cases and comma escaping (Eunovo)
Support for future extensibility like per-endpoint permissions (Sjors)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it closes an unconstrained file descriptor allocation hazard that could crash the node
Provides capacity management and independent limits for distinct consumers like GUI or mining clients
